title: Creative Visualizer (Design & Motion)
intro: At CAP, we don’t just create visuals — we create impact. We’re looking for a bold, fast-thinking Creative Designer who can turn ideas into scroll-stopping content and brand experiences that actually convert.
responsibilities: Design high-quality creatives for social media, campaigns, branding, and digital platforms.
Develop concepts, layouts, and visual directions for marketing campaigns.
Create engaging content including static posts, carousels, ads, and promotional materials.
Work closely with marketing, content, and business teams to deliver client-focused solutions.
Maintain brand consistency across all visual outputs.
Handle client feedback, revisions, and quick turnaround updates.
Stay updated with design trends, tools, and platform requirements.
Handle multiple projects under tight deadlines without compromising quality.
requirements: Proven experience as a Creative/Graphic Designer with a strong commercial portfolio.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects); video editing is a plus.
Strong skills in Canva and modern AI design tools.
Solid understanding of branding, typography, color, and layout.
Ability to translate ideas into high-impact visuals with strong attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
preferred: Experience in advertising agency, digital marketing, or creative industry.
Motion graphics and basic video editing.
Strong AI design skills using tools like ChatGPT, Higgsfield AI, Canva AI, and Adobe Firefly.
Hand drawing and sketching skills will be preferred.
Understanding of social media algorithms and content performance.
offer: Opportunity to work on diverse brands and campaigns.
Fast career growth in a high-performance environment.
extraHeading: The kind of designer we want
extra: Thinks beyond design and understands business impact.
Can turn a simple idea into a powerful visual story.
Is hungry to grow, learn, and stand out.

title: Business Development Manager
intro: At CAP Ltd, we’re looking for a high-performing, target-driven professional who can bring in clients, build strong business relationships, and drive revenue growth in the advertising, marketing, and creative industry.
responsibilities: Build and maintain a strong pipeline of new business opportunities.
Use your network to generate leads and open doors.
Identify, approach, and convert potential clients across industries.
Lead outreach through LinkedIn, referrals, networking, and market research.
Prepare presentations, proposals, budgets, and commercial plans.
Coordinate with internal teams to develop tailored solutions.
Negotiate and close deals while maintaining profitability.
Build long-term client relationships and ensure repeat business.
Track market trends, competitor activity, and business opportunities.
Maintain reporting, forecasting, and CRM records.
requirements: Proven experience in Business Development, Sales, Client Service, or Account Management.
Prior experience in an advertising, digital, creative, media, branding, or related industry.
An existing client base and strong industry connections.
Strong pitching, negotiation, and closing skills.
Ability to generate business independently.
Knowledge of Canva, Microsoft Excel, budgeting, and proposal development.
Familiarity with CRM tools, LinkedIn outreach, and Microsoft 365.
Strong commercial sense, strategic thinking, and a results-driven mindset.
Working knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, Canva AI, or similar platforms.
offer: Attractive salary package with performance-based incentives.
A dynamic, young, and energetic work environment.

title: Client Service Executive
tagline: Great ideas need the right people to bring them to life!
intro: Content Analytics Production Ltd. (CAP) is looking for a proactive, creative, and organized Client Service Executive to join our growing team. If you enjoy building client relationships, coordinating creative projects, and turning ideas into successful outcomes, we’d love to hear from you!
requirements: Experience: 1–3 years.
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
Experience in client servicing or project coordination.
Excellent communication skills in Bangla and English.
Strong presentation skills and proficiency in Canva, PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
Ability to manage client relationships, deadlines, and multiple projects.
Understanding of branding and digital marketing is a plus.
offer: A collaborative and growth-focused work environment.
extra: Send your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a sample presentation or pitch deck.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. CAP is an equal opportunity employer.
